title: Inlet Beach "Sandy Lane" 212 Walton Rose Lane
h1: Inlet Beach "Sandy Lane" 212 Walton Rose Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $35 per day**- Spacious porches - Outdoor firepit- 7 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Enjoy enchanting Gulf views at "Sandy Lane" in Inlet Beach! This fabulous house is located on the cusp of Rosemary and Inlet Beach on the coveted Walton Rose Lane. With 7 bedrooms and 7.5 bathrooms, there are comfortable accommodations for up to 20 guests. The home's incredible amenities include a private pool, fire pit, carriage house, and multiple sprawling porches. It's professionally designed with functionality and luxury in mind, with notable features such as handcrafted Venetian plaster finishes and top-of-the-line appliances. The first floor's kitchen and living room have awe-inspiring details, from the backsplash to the fireplace to the light fixtures. There is combined seating for 15 guests to enjoy a meal together at the dining table and island. The first bedroom is down the hall with a king bed and private bathroom. On the second floor, guests will find 2 more bedrooms, each with a king bed and a private bathroom. There is also a laundry room with multiple, full-size appliances, and a secondary living room that includes a full-over-full built-in bunk. The third floor has an identical floor plan as the second, with the only difference being there are 2 bunks instead of 1. There is a ping pong table in the living area and a balcony with Gulf views on this floor as well. The spiral staircase leads to a lookout tower that has its own sitting area, perfect for sipping a cocktail or enjoying a morning coffee. There is also a carriage house accompanying the home that has a king bedroom and 2 twins in the loft. It has its own living room and kitchenette with natural, wooden cabinetry and a flat-screen TV. Enjoy use of the lovely grilling area under the veranda that has beautiful patio furniture and an outdoor dining table. The large pool with the home comes with lounge seating and a fire pit to enjoy year-round. The home has 7 adult bikes that are meant for cruising around 30A or around the neighborhood! You can do it all here. Don't miss your chance to stay at "Sandy Lane" and book today! SLEEPING ARRANGMENTS:FIRST FLOOR: Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate Bonus Room: Full-over-Full Built-in Bunk bedsTHIRD FLOOR: Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Common Bathroom: Shower onlyAdditional Living Area: Two Full-over-Full Bunk bedsCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Two Twins in Loft, Private Bathroom with Shower Only**Please note, the elevator and indoor fireplace are not for guest use.**Please be advised that weddings, and large gatherings are strictly prohibited at this property. Events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by 360 Blue. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
